posts.author: shreyesh_jain
posts.text: It’s suspicious about the unsecured loan, but when this was asked in the concall, the company said that the repayment of the loan from Burberry Infra is in line with their FY27 expectations. They also said that they are earning 12% interest on the loan, which is higher than the interest rate at which the company borrows. They also mentioned that ₹31 crore of debt was recently repaid by the Burberry infra. Another suspicious aspect of Transrail is that when you look at the pre-IPO shareholding, there appear to be 3–4 layers between the actual promoters and the listed company.

posts.text: Got this from AI Related-Party ICDs: ₹79 Cr unsecured loan to Burberry Infra (used to acquire Gammon’s distressed asset Deepmala Infra) was repeatedly rolled over and flagged by statutory auditors. Former CFO Rajesh Neelakantan held overlapping directorships across these entities. Pre-IPO Promoter Structuring: FPCCL acquired a 40% stake in late 2023 at an entry multiple of ~4.5x FY23 PAT, followed by an IPO exit/listing at ~23x P/E within 15 months.
